meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 构建或修改界面后,它会截取实际画面并与参考图做像素对比,并行派出两名只读审查员分别核查设计系统一致性、视觉与中日韩等文字细节,最后给出通过、需修改或失败的明确结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何界面、组件后,或用户问到某页面或终端界面是否显示正确时触发;也适用于像素对比、设计系统核查、CJK 文字裁切等视觉验收请求。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,做个视觉QA。
say.note: 会截图并与参考图对比。

say.text: 请把设计稿和实际页面截图做像素对比。
say.note: 会按参考包逐页与截图核对。

say.text: 看看这个终端界面的对齐和边框有没有问题。
say.note: 会跑TUI宽度与边框对齐检查。

howto.what_en: After any UI change, Claude captures actual renders, pixel-compares them against references, runs two read-only QA passes (design-system/functional and visual/CJK), then outputs a clear PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Use after any UI change, when a user asks whether a page or TUI looks right, or for visual-acceptance requests like pixel diff, design-system checks, or CJK clipping.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page—run a visual QA.
say_en.note: Captures a screenshot and runs a pixel comparison.

say_en.text: Pixel-compare this design mock with the actual page screenshot.
Check this terminal UI for alignment or border issues.
say_en.note: Runs TUI width and border-alignment checks.
